- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.5) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 5–10% for next 5–7 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (≥ 10% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +5% above peak for 3–5 days.  
- If sentiment is negative (≤ -0.5) and price is trending down, model frequently underestimates; add 3–7% to forecast for next 3–7 days.  
- Model consistently overestimates early in 30-day horizon; apply 10–15% downward bias for first 7–10 days.  
- If sentiment flips from negative to positive mid-horizon, model lags in adjusting; anticipate 2–3 day delay in price reversal; adjust forecast accordingly.  
- Mean reversion is strong in 10–14 day window; if forecast exceeds 20% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 10–15% for next 5 days.
